postPatchSql: UPDATE chat_scripts SET status='active' WHERE status='draft' AND "packId" IS NULL
releaseNotes:
vmfix30 — 4 fixes + Tier 2 patch infrastructure

1. Self-built chat scripts now default to ACTIVE status (so they appear in 「Specify Script」 dropdown immediately)
2. listPacks now filters by tenant (no more cross-tenant pack name leak)
3. supervisor heartbeat now detects dead child processes and auto-restarts (max 3 attempts) — agent will no longer silently disappear
4. Patch infrastructure introduced: future fixes ship as 5-10 MB zip via Apply-Patch.ps1 instead of full 145 MB installer

This patch automatically activates any DRAFT chat scripts you created before upgrading.
